name: Soap Drop
description: A drop of soap touches the first clip, which floats on water like a skin: the skin rushes away from the drop and piles up into a glossy, wrinkled rim that is shoved out of the frame, leaving the second clip under clear, rippling water. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Where the drop touches the skin (0..1, y down)

params.name: crumple
params.description: How much the piled-up skin wrinkles
